name: Heat flow with inset (a) + cumulative heat with group brackets (b)
use_case: The complete calorimetry figure: heat flow with the first hours as an inset, beside cumulative heat with brackets that group the samples. Groups are yours; without groups no bracket is drawn.

data_roles.regimes: your groups: a name and the samples in it

origin_hint: Origin: two line graphs merged 1 × 2; inset via Graph > New Layer; brackets via Insert > Line.
calculations: cumulative heat (J/g) = integral of heat flow (mW/g) over time (h) × 3.6
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
